landing.headline: MarudhamX plans perishable produce transport along real road networks and calculates exact truck requirements.
landing.subline: Receive turnkey road routing, optimal truck allocations, and comprehensive transport and spoilage cost estimates in seconds.
landing.badge: Real Road Routing & Truck Split Optimization

card1.title: Real Road Routing
card1.description: Computes distinct routes mapped to physical road networks, evaluating highway bypasses and toll corridors.

card2.title: Exact Truck Allocations
card2.description: Calculates required truck counts and payload distribution based on vehicle capacity constraints.

card3.title: Transport & Loss Estimates
card3.description: Provides itemized diesel, toll, and driver costs paired with exponential crop spoilage risk calculations.
